name: AI Video Clipper — AI Combo Pipeline

nodes.name: AI Combo Trigger
nodes.notes: Automation entry. Send a topic (plus optional customScript, segmentCount, language, format, voiceover). This file holds no credential values — the site routes called below are rate-limited, and the single-call webhook route documents its own authorization setup separately.

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Later steps read the voiceover flag and format back from this node, because HTTP steps replace each item with their own response.

nodes.name: Generate Script
nodes.notes: The site's own script route (Groq, then Gemini, then OpenRouter). No provider configured means an honest 503 here — the run stops, no script is invented.

nodes.name: Split Segments
nodes.notes: One item per script segment, so the visuals step runs once per segment.

nodes.name: Find Verified Visuals
nodes.notes: Licence check happens here, before any bytes move: the route returns only Commons videos that pass the exact licence verification (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC0, public domain). Unverified, NC, ND, and unknown licences are refused, never passed on.

nodes.name: Merge Segments With Visuals
nodes.notes: Rejoins each segment with its visuals response (HTTP steps replace items, so the segment text would otherwise be lost). If your n8n shows a version warning here, open the node and re-pick Combine, then Merge by Position.

nodes.name: Attach Visual
nodes.notes: First verified visual per segment, or a recorded gap. A segment with no visual is never filled with an unverified file.

nodes.name: Build Subtitles
nodes.notes: SRT + VTT from the same 5-second windows the browser composer plays. Pure text building — no media bytes pass through this workflow.

nodes.name: Voiceover Wanted?
nodes.notes: Only calls the voiceover route when voiceover was requested AND the script fits the route's 500-character limit. Otherwise the slot records a skip and the job continues.

nodes.name: Request Voiceover
nodes.notes: Continues on failure: a missing voiceover never blocks the job. When the voiceover route has no provider configured it answers 503, and the next step records a skip.

nodes.name: Resolve Voiceover Slot
nodes.notes: Audio presence is judged by binary data, never assumed. No audio means a recorded skip, never a fake voice.

nodes.name: Voiceover Not Requested
nodes.notes: The skip reason says which case it is: not asked for, or too long for the voiceover route.

nodes.name: Build Render-Job Record
nodes.notes: This record is NOT a video. It is the handoff to the browser renderer or the ffmpeg worker — nothing here claims a render happened.

nodes.name: Build Post Wiring
nodes.notes: Wiring only: the clip id, title, and hashtags the post panel needs, plus the rule that nothing counts as posted until a real share records it.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Answers the webhook caller with the full job record.
